verdict.rationale: Authenticator has its own 'Usage Data' toggle in Settings that controls whether additional non-personal usage data is shared, and diagnostic logs stay on the device unless the user chooses Send feedback. The word 'additional' implies some baseline data collection that cannot be turned off, and the docs never describe a complete telemetry opt-out. A community comment citing an Exodus Privacy report says the app tracks location constantly, but it does not show the toggle failing, so it lowers confidence rather than making this a dispute. Missing for 10: documented full opt-out of all telemetry (including required or baseline data), a description of what is still collected when the toggle is off, and independent hands-on verification of the toggle's effect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: You can also allow the sharing of additional non-personal usage data by turning on the "Usage Data" toggle button on the app's Settings page.
Diagnostic log data that stays only in the app until you select Send feedback in the app's top menu to send logs to Microsoft.
